subject: geography
title: People of the UK: Foundations

concepts.def: About 67 million people, growing slowly each year.
Average ~280 people per km2, much higher in cities.
England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
About 84% of UK people live in urban areas.
London has roughly 9 million residents in Greater London.
Varied ethnic, religious and cultural mix, especially in cities. 🇬🇧

walkthroughs.body_html:
The UK has about 67 million people.

Population grows slowly, mainly due to immigration and longer lifespans.

Density averages ~280 per km2.

Most people are urban.

About 84% live in towns and cities.

The rest live in villages and the countryside.

The UK has four nations.

England is by far the largest with around 56 million.

Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland make up the rest.
